imageSpec.description: Container image configuration with two-tier registry resolution

registry.description: Overrides global.imageRegistry for this image only

tag.description: Image tag. Quote in YAML to avoid float parsing (e.g. '18.0')

digest.description: Image digest (e.g. sha256:abc...). When set, takes precedence over tag

platform.description: Platform implementation: 'python' (default, runs the Python monolith core pod) or 'go' (runs the Go GWE pod; AWE/STR land in subsequent PRs). Python mode is unchanged from prior releases. Go mode renders a distinct deployment set and expects the Go DSN scheme in secrets.

enabled.description: Enable RBAC authorization. When disabled, all users have unrestricted access.

dnsName.description: DNS name for accessing the web UI and API (e.g. sam.example.com). Optional for port-forward and Ingress; required for LoadBalancer/NodePort access.

fe.description: Optional overrides for the FE's API base URL (consumed via /api/v1/config). Omit entirely to derive from sam.dnsName (default, current behavior). Set apiBaseUrl/platformBaseUrl to "" for same-origin (port-forward, embedding) or to an absolute http(s) URL for explicit cross-origin topologies. Only affects the FE config response — OAuth callback URLs, MCP gateway issuer, and connector service URL continue to use sam.dnsName.

apiBaseUrl.description: Override for the FE's webuiServerUrl. Empty string forces same-origin; otherwise must be an http(s) URL.

platformBaseUrl.description: Override for the FE's platformServerUrl. Empty string forces same-origin; otherwise must be an http(s) URL.

sessionSecretKey.description: Session encryption secret. Leave empty to auto-generate on first install (stable across upgrades).

providerName.description: Name of the entry in the binary's oidc_providers.yaml catalog to dispatch to. Empty falls back to the binary's default (`azure`).

frontendServerUrl.description: Override computed frontend URL (e.g. behind a reverse proxy or for local dev)

platformServiceUrl.description: Override computed platform API URL (e.g. behind a reverse proxy or for local dev)

allowedOriginRegex.description: Regex pattern for additional allowed CORS origins

taskLogging.description: Task logging configuration (requires SQL session storage)

authenticationRbac.description: RBAC configuration. Choose ONE method: static users OR idpClaims (dynamic from IDP).

disableBuiltinRoles.description: Suppress built-in sam_admin/sam_user roles from the rendered role-to-scope-definitions.yaml (default false). Enable when role definitions are owned by DB-managed RBAC via `sam config apply`.

idpClaims.description: Dynamic role assignment from IDP claims (alternative to static users)

claimKey.description: OIDC claim key to extract roles from.

mappings.description: Map IDP claim values to SAM roles

defaultRoles.description: Default roles assigned to users not matching any explicit assignment or IDP mapping

broker.description: Solace event broker connection configuration. Only used when global.broker.embedded is false.

clientUsername.description: Client username for authenticating with the Solace event broker

password.description: Client password for authenticating with the Solace event broker

llmService.description: LLM service configuration for AI model access

planningModel.description: Model name for planning tasks (e.g. gpt-4o)

imageModel.description: Model name for image generation (e.g. dall-e-3)

transcriptionModel.description: Model name for audio transcription (e.g. whisper-1)

toolApiKeys.description: Credentials and endpoints consumed by built-in tools and bundled agents (image, audio, research). Empty values are omitted from the rendered Secret.

geminiApiBase.description: GEMINI_API_BASE — image-agent generation endpoint. Defaults to the public Google endpoint; override for air-gap / internal LLM proxy.

googleSearchApiBase.description: GOOGLE_SEARCH_API_BASE — research-agent web search endpoint. Defaults to the public Google endpoint; override for air-gap / internal proxy.

type.description: Service type: One of ClusterIP, NodePort, or LoadBalancer

nodePorts.description: NodePort assignments (30000-32767). Only used when type=NodePort; leave empty for auto-assignment.

tls.description: TLS/SSL configuration for pod-level TLS termination

enabled.description: Enable TLS on the service. Controls health check ports, URL scheme, and TLS secret creation.

existingSecret.description: Name of an existing kubernetes.io/tls Secret (alternative to inline cert/key)

passphrase.description: TLS private key passphrase (passed to TLS server library)

ingress.description: Kubernetes Ingress configuration. App-level fields are typed; K8s fields (annotations, hosts, tls) are allowed but not restricted.

enabled.description: Enable Ingress resource creation. Affects OAuth redirect URL computation.

className.description: Ingress class name (e.g. nginx, traefik, alb)

autoConfigurePaths.description: Auto-generate all required ingress paths (recommended). Set to false for custom routing.

host.description: Hostname for auto-configured ingress paths. Leave empty for ALB controllers.

hosts.description: Manual hosts/paths configuration. Only used when autoConfigurePaths is false.

tls.description: TLS configuration (secretName + hosts). Presence triggers HTTPS URL generation.

environmentVariables.description: Custom environment variables injected into the SAM core deployment. Can be a map of key-value pairs or a multiline KEY=VALUE string.

global.description: Global configuration shared across chart and subcharts

imageRegistry.description: Default container image registry for all images (e.g. gcr.io/gcp-maas-prod). Per-image override via image.registry.

imagePullSecrets.description: Image pull secrets applied to ALL pods (core, agent-deployer, postgresql, seaweedfs)

imagePullKey.description: Pull-credentials JSON for private registries. Expects the K8s Secret data shape `{ ".dockerconfigjson": "<base64>" }`. Use --set-file global.imagePullKey=path/to/creds.json.

podRuntimes.description: Named pod runtime profiles (gVisor, Kata, Firecracker, etc.). Each profile couples runtimeClassName, nodeSelector, and tolerations — the three fields a sandbox runtime always needs together. Reference a profile from a workload via samDeployment.{component}.podRuntime: <profile-name>. Referencing an unknown profile, or referencing a profile whose runtimeClassName is empty, fails the render.

runtimeClassName.description: Name of the Kubernetes RuntimeClass to use (e.g. gvisor, kata). Required: a profile without a runtimeClassName would defeat the security intent.

nodeSelector.description: Node labels required for pods using this profile (may be empty if the runtime is installed cluster-wide)

tolerations.description: Tolerations required for pods using this profile (may be empty if nodes are not tainted)

embedded.description: Deploy an embedded Solace broker (dev/quickstart only). When false, provide connection details for an external broker in the top-level 'broker' section.

namespaceId.description: Unique identifier for this SAM installation. Used for database names, S3 bucket scoping, and topic namespacing.

enabled.description: Enable bundled PostgreSQL + SeaweedFS (dev/POC only). Set to false for production with external datastores.

name.description: Service account name. Must also match persistence-layer.postgresql/seaweedfs.serviceAccountName when using bundled persistence.

imagePullSecret.description: Image pull secret name attached to the service account for private registries

chartVersion.description: Chart version for the solace-agent-mesh-agent chart

kubeApiHost.description: Kubernetes API host the deployer's helm client dials. Override applied only when HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY is set; allows the .svc NO_PROXY rule to bypass the proxy. Empty string disables the override.

gwe.description: GWE (Gateway Executor) pod configuration. Rendered when sam.platform is 'go'. Dispatches HTTP to gateway handlers, the platform service, and static assets on a single port.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the GWE container

podRuntime.description: Sandbox pod runtime profile name (must be defined in global.podRuntimes). Empty disables sandbox runtime selection for this workload.

awe.description: AWE (Agent-Workflow Executor) pod configuration. Rendered when sam.platform is 'go'. Runs agent workflows; shares GWE's container image — leave image.repository empty to inherit gwe.image.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the AWE container

extraConfigs.description: Additional --config file paths passed to sam-awe alongside the default sam.yaml. Used to enable optional baked agents (e.g. doc-converter.yaml) on a per-environment basis.

podRuntime.description: Sandbox pod runtime profile name (must be defined in global.podRuntimes). Empty disables sandbox runtime selection for this workload.

str.description: STR (Secure Tool Runtime) pod configuration. Rendered when sam.platform is 'go'. Authenticates tool invocations and executes baked Go + Python tools; the Python venvs live only in this image. Falls back to gwe.image if repository is blanked (WARNING: silently breaks tool execution).

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the STR container

podRuntime.description: Sandbox pod runtime profile name (must be defined in global.podRuntimes). Empty disables sandbox runtime selection for this workload.

customCA.description: Custom CA certificate injection. Enables a ca-merge init container that appends *.crt files from a ConfigMap onto the system CA bundle.

enabled.description: Enable custom CA bundle injection via ca-merge init container

configMapName.description: Name of the ConfigMap in the release namespace containing *.crt files

caInitImage.description: Optional image override for the ca-merge init container. Defaults to samDeployment.image when empty. Must be a Debian-based image (needs /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt). Only used when samDeployment.customCA.enabled is true.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for sam and agentDeployer containers

extraSecretEnvironmentVars.description: Reference values from existing Kubernetes Secrets as environment variables

secretName.description: Name of the existing Kubernetes Secret

secretKey.description: Key within the Secret to read the value from

dataStores.description: External datastore configuration (database and object storage)

applicationPassword.description: Application database user password. Required when global.persistence.enabled=false.

supabaseTenantId.description: Supabase project ID for connection pooler username qualification

enabled.description: Use workload identity for object storage authentication (no access keys)

evalDataBucketName.description: Optional S3 bucket for eval execution data; defaults to bucketName when empty

containerName.description: Azure blob container for data storage

connectorSpecContainerName.description: Azure blob container for connector specs

evalDataContainerName.description: Optional Azure blob container for eval execution data; defaults to containerName when empty

evalDataBucketName.description: Optional GCS bucket for eval execution data; defaults to bucketName when empty

embeddedBroker.description: Embedded Solace broker configuration. Only deployed when global.broker.embedded is true.

imagePullSecrets.description: Component-level image pull secrets (merged with global.imagePullSecrets)

resources.description: Kubernetes resource requests and limits. Minimum memory: 2480Mi.

storageClassName.description: Storage class name for broker PVC. Uses cluster default if not specified.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector for broker pod scheduling

samDoctor.description: Pre-install/upgrade validation hook (sam-doctor). Runs as a Helm pre-install/pre-upgrade job to validate configuration before deploying SAM.

failOnError.description: When false, the hook always exits 0 even when checks fail

tlsDnsName.description: DNS name used to validate the TLS certificate. Defaults to sam.dnsName if unset.

validations.description: Template-time cluster resource existence checks. Looks up referenced Secrets, ConfigMaps, StorageClasses, and IngressClasses before install to surface missing resources early. Requires 'get' RBAC on each referenced resource.

clusterResourceChecks.description: Enable template-time existence checks for referenced cluster resources. Set to false if the service account lacks 'get' permission.

volumes.description: Shared filesystem volume store for the SAM 'volumes' feature. When enabled, an existing RWX PVC is mounted at mountPath on the gwe, str, and awe pods so the gateway volume_service store and the STR tool mounts share one filesystem.

enabled.description: Mount the shared volumes PVC on the gwe/str/awe pods. Off by default.

existingClaim.description: Name of an existing RWX (ReadWriteMany) PVC, e.g. EFS-backed. Required when enabled.

mountPath.description: Path the shared volume is mounted at inside each pod.

sam-common.description: sam-common library subchart values (no-op at render time; library chart)

deploymentId.description: Optional deployment identifier label on the Service resource

dataStores.description: Cannot provide external datastore configuration when global.persistence.enabled is true. Either set global.persistence.enabled to false and provide datastore credentials, or remove the datastore configuration to use bundled persistence.

host.description: Must be empty when using bundled persistence

adminUsername.description: Must be empty when using bundled persistence

adminPassword.description: Must be empty when using bundled persistence

applicationPassword.description: Must be empty when using bundled persistence

endpointUrl.description: Must be empty when using bundled persistence

accessKey.description: Must be empty when using bundled persistence

secretKey.description: Must be empty when using bundled persistence

accountName.description: Must be empty when using bundled persistence

accountKey.description: Must be empty when using bundled persistence

connectionString.description: Must be empty when using bundled persistence

project.description: Must be empty when using bundled persistence

credentialsJson.description: Must be empty when using bundled persistence
